summary: Frontend-only validation of the three new/updated flows: (1) Custom date-range report on /dashboard/reports, (2) Email delivery settings panel with persistence across reload, and (3) Provider Stability panel on /dashboard/provider-health. All three flows pass end-to-end after fixing one real testability bug in the shared Panel component that was silently dropping data-testid (and every other extra prop). After the fix, [data-testid=email-settings-panel], [data-testid=stability-mock-sandbox] and other Panel-wrapped testids are queryable. Custom-range: empty dates -> 'Pick a start and end date' error toast, no row created; valid dates (2025-01-01..2025-01-31) -> new row appears with 'custom' type label. Email settings: 'no provider connected' badge visible, toggling enable/recipient/frequencies/attach CSV all work, Save shows 'Email report settings saved' toast, all values survive a full page reload (enabled=true, recipient=test-reports@example.com, daily=true, weekly=false, monthly=true, attach=false). Provider Stability: default tenant (Empty Co) shows stability-empty state; switching ACTIVE TENANT to 'Acme Commerce' renders stability-mock-sandbox card with numeric score (85), 'stable' rating label, filled progress bar (h-full.rounded-full div), and '1 drop · 1 recovery' line. Alert Recovery Log below still renders 2 history entries for Acme (unchanged from iter 13).
action_items: Review and keep the Panel prop-spread fix (src/components/common.jsx). Without it, several critical testids that E1 spec'd (email-settings-panel, stability-<key>-<env>, and any future Panel-wrapped panels) are silently dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: src/components/common.jsx Panel used to accept only {children, className} and drop all other props including data-testid. This silently defeats any data-testid placed on a <Panel> in JSX. Fixed by spreading ...rest onto the underlying div. Recommend applying the same {...rest} pattern to EmptyState and StatusBadge to future-proof.
Reports.jsx StatusBadge status='active' is still hardcoded per iter_13 review (cosmetic).
ProviderHealth.jsx still polls every 15s with 5 parallel requests per tick; consider pausing on document.hidden.
